summary: Each q_w (w ∈ I) is a prime not dividing ℓg₀g₁N, since w is not a bad place.

steps.claim: It suffices that ℓ·(g₀g₁N) is coprime to ∏_{w∈I} q_w (Nat.coprime_mul_iff_left).
steps.lean: ℓ.Coprime (∏ w ∈ I, w.q) ∧ (D.gProd * D.N).Coprime (∏ w ∈ I, w.q) := Nat.coprime_mul_iff_left.1

steps.claim: Each q_w is prime (I auxiliary) and does not divide ℓg₀g₁N: otherwise ℓg₀g₁N would lie in the prime w (which contains q_w), making w a bad place, while w ∉ badPlaces D ℓ.
steps.lean:
(.symm (.prod_left fun w h ↦ (c w h).2.1.coprime_iff_not_dvd.2 ((c w h).1 <| by
    simpa [badPlaces] using w.1.mem_of_dvd ·.natCast w.1.absNorm_mem)))
